_meta.note: zones.*.alarms.solTempMaxC is the farm details form's (R-1, section 8). ecMaxMsCm is set to limits.json ecCeiling, the top of the form's target range. There is no circulation flow sensor, so no circFlowMinLpm. The events are client_A's, proposed for the team to check, with two changes for a real farm: RESERVOIR_LOW is the low level, 20 % of each zone's 90 L main tank = 18 L (review of #82), and waits 60 s so a ripple doesn't flap it. DAYTANK_LOW never fires: the drums have no level sensors. Phase A alerts are in the app only. T1-34: DEVICE_OFFLINE once the rig has sent nothing for thresholdS (contract 14: 180 s) or its last will came, READING_STALE once a zone's readings are older than thresholdS (contract 14: 120 s) while its controller is online, and SENSOR_FAULT from a reading the rig can't measure. Power at the farm is intermittent, so each waits 60 s before it is raised; proposed for the team to check.
